what: Certified lower bound for the topological entropy of the Hénon map x' = 1 − a x² + b y, y' = x (parameters are the exact doubles nearest the stated values). The h-sets are pairwise disjoint parallelograms; each edge is a covering relation for F itself, verified as strict interval inequalities with outward rounding; the spectral bound is exact (BigInt row sums). Consumes one external theorem: covering relations imply semi-conjugacy to the subshift (Zgliczynski–Gidea).
